{{Quote|Here is the location where you can meet the Fariso. Captain Marsh can be terse, but is not really a bad person.|The [[Endor Space Station|Endor Space Station]] comms officer, to a pilot|<ref name="SWG:BitF" />}}
The '''''Fariso''''' was a civilian [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]] that operated during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==History==
[[File:Fariso_Endor_station.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The ''Fariso'' approaching the [[Endor Space Station]]]]
{{Quote|Maybe I'll just stick my blaster out a window, I must have monkeys manning my turrets.|[[Jenson Marsh]]|<ref name="SWG:BitF" />}}
The ''Fariso'' was operated by a retired [[TIE pilot]] named [[Jenson Marsh]].<ref name="SWG:BitF" /> During [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> the ''Fariso'' was tasked with carrying important cargo to the [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] [[Endor Space Station|Space Station]]. To ensure that the ''Fariso'' made it safely, a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] escorted the YT-1300 and defended it from attacking [[Evil Raiders|Evil Raider]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]].<ref name="SWG:BitF" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Fariso'' appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:BitF" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The ''Fariso'' was added to the game with the release of the expansion pack [[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed|''Jump to Lightspeed'']] on [[October 27]], [[2004]].<ref name="SWG:BitF" />
